name: marker
description: A source-owned small inline annotation chip (step number, tool-call badge, citation marker) for chat/agent messages.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational; no dedicated primitive dependency (task 10.1's own audit). Upstream's root part declares asChild; this ecosystem's existing caller-composition answer is used instead of replicating that polymorphism (see registry/ui/marker.rs's own header comment).
documentation.accessibility: Renders as inline content with no assigned role (registry/ui/marker.rs); its text is read as ordinary content by assistive technology.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.
